steps.title: Analyze Product Detail Crash
steps.description: Locate and diagnose the NullPointerException / crash occurring in ProductDetailActivity when instantiating MainActivity and invoking lifecycle methods directly.

steps.title: Refactor Product Catalog
steps.description: Expose the mock shoe list inside a static thread-safe catalog method within Product.java to decouple product query logic from active lifecycle contexts.

steps.title: Unify MainActivity Data Source
steps.description: Configure MainActivity to read its active product lineup directly from the newly centralized static product catalog helper.

steps.title: Repair ProductDetailActivity Queries
steps.description: Change ProductDetailActivity to load details using Product.getProductById(shoeId) rather than constructing new MainActivity instances.

steps.title: Ensure Safe Intent Retrievals
steps.description: Add null safety validations in ProductDetailActivity for cases when shoe_id parameter is absent or corrupted.

steps.title: Examine Image Resource Bindings
steps.description: Ensure the dynamic layout inflation correctly maps image arrays to layout views using the ImageLoader module.

steps.title: Verify Dynamic Cart Save Settings
steps.description: Check that the shared preferences state contains consistent parameters matching local schema names for seamless checkout sync.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Confirm that all newly introduced code utilizes traditional anonymous inner classes instead of Java 8+ lambdas or stream API.

steps.title: Verify Layout Integrity
steps.description: Ensure layout margins and scaleType styles correctly display wide images across multiple Android display sizes.

steps.title: Building Shozica Premor
steps.description: Compile the complete verified project files to execute the final build signature check successfully.
